summary: Beazer Homes filed an 8-K disclosing supplemental indentures tied to its pending merger with Dream Finders Homes under the August 6, 2026 merger agreement. Dream Finders ran a consent solicitation that expired September 15, 2026, extended only for the 8.000% 2032 notes to September 17, 2026; requisite holders approved amending the Change of Control definition so the merger is not a change of control. The indentures took effect immediately, but amendments become operative only once consent fees are paid, expected concurrently with merger closing. Watch regulatory clearance, consent-fee funding, and any change-of-control noteholder challenge.
